findings.F1: Weekend daily moves reverse the next day far more than weekday moves. Saturday and Sunday returns, scaled by the coin's own 20-day volatility, give a next-day excess-return slope of -0.0042 per unit. The Monday-to-Thursday slope is -0.0010 (n=19173), a difference with z = -4.67.
findings.F2: The weekend reversal holds widely and is graded in both directions. The slope is negative in 17 of 19 coins and in all 8 years (t from -0.59 in 2023 to -6.14 in 2019). By weekend-move quintile, the next-day excess return runs +0.53% (t 3.97, n=1919) after the largest falls, then -0.11%, -0.17%, -0.40%, and -0.56% (t -4.26, n=1919) after the largest rises.
findings.F3: A Sunday bar's own one-day move is undone over Monday and Tuesday on both sides. By Sunday z-quintile, the Monday-Tuesday excess return is +1.00% (t 3.96) and +0.90% (t 3.67) in the two falling quintiles. It is -0.43%, -0.90% (t -3.42) and -0.57% (t -2.21) in the three rising quintiles, about 956 cases each. The tested plan only shorted the rising half.
findings.F4: The two-day Saturday-plus-Sunday return does not predict Monday-Tuesday (pooled slope -0.0002, t -0.18, n=4717). The reversal is a one-day-back, one-day-ahead effect, not a whole-weekend effect.
findings.F5: Contrary to the brief, the weekend reversal is not stronger when volume is thin. By the bar's volume relative to its 28-day median, the slopes are -0.0039 (low tercile, t -2.54), -0.0043 (middle) and -0.0044 (high, t -5.42), about 3198 cases each.
findings.F6: The book barely earns from the effect it holds. It is in the market only on Monday, where its mean daily return is +0.00022 (t 0.80, n=5270). Sunday's rebalancing costs -0.00021 a day (t -19.4), so fees take almost all of the Monday gain.

ideas.idea: A coin's one-day return on a Saturday or a Sunday, measured against its own recent daily volatility, is reversed over the next day. The larger the weekend day's rise, the larger the next day's fall, and the larger its fall, the larger the next day's rise.
ideas.consequence: Fade each weekend day's move for one day in both directions, sized by how unusual the move was, and do not trade a weekday move the same way.
ideas.name: weekend day one-day reversal

ideas.idea: A coin that fell on Sunday (its Saturday-close to Sunday-close return, measured against its own recent daily volatility) rises over the next 2 days, and the larger the Sunday fall, the larger the rise.
ideas.consequence: The Sunday-close fade should also buy Sunday falls, not only short Sunday rises, which roughly doubles the cases the tested strategy acts on.
ideas.name: Sunday fall rebounds early-week
